text:
Decisions
- The coupon field moves above the order total in the next release.

Action items
- Arun: ship the coupon field change (due 5 September)
- Priya: rerun the usability test with four people (due 12 September)

Open questions
- Whether to keep the old checkout behind a flag for enterprise customers; ask sales first.

Decisions
- No-go for the mobile release today; re-check on Friday.

Action items
- Neha: merge the Android 12 image picker fix and ship it to beta (due Thursday)
- Karthik: pull the crash-free numbers again (due Friday morning)

Open questions
None

Decisions
- Annual discount wording becomes "save 20 percent compared to monthly billing".

Action items
- Joseph: update the pricing page wording (no date)
- Rahul: update the three ads with the agency (due 5 September)
- Sana: email the agency about the new wording (due today)

Open questions
- Whether the discount should also be shown in rupees.

Decisions
- A tag is required when closing a ticket.

Action items
- Farhan: make the tag required in the helpdesk settings (due 8 September)
- Divya: tell the support team in stand-up (no date)

Open questions
- Whether to backfill tags on old tickets.

Decisions
- The Q4 roadmap will contain invoice download in the app and the new onboarding flow, which the team discussed at length in this review. Saved carts, which was estimated by Arun at two full sprints of engineering work, has been moved out of Q4 and into Q1 of next year so that the team can focus on the two items with the highest expected impact on activation and support volume.

Action items
- Priya: produce the onboarding designs, covering the full new user journey from sign-up through the first completed order, including the empty states and the error states that the current flow does not handle well (due 26 September)
- Arun: size the onboarding work once Priya's designs have landed and have been reviewed by the team, so that it can be scheduled into the right sprint (no date)
- Karthik: start work on invoice download in the mobile app during the next sprint, in parallel with the web version, so that both ship together in Q4 (due next sprint)

Open questions
- Whether the onboarding change could be risky for existing users who are already familiar with the current flow and might be confused by the new steps, and whether a gradual rollout or a feature flag would be needed to reduce that risk before launch.

Decisions
- Chat transcripts older than 18 months are deleted every month.

Action items
- Neha: switch on the monthly deletion job (due 15 September)

Decisions
None

Action items
- Vikram: tell the payments partner the new date (due today)
- Meera: update the launch plan and the press note (due Friday)

Open questions
- Whether the 2 October webinar still happens.

Note: this summary meets all criteria and should be rated 3/3.

Decisions
- The backend engineer role opens to referrals only for two weeks, then goes public.

Action items
- Divya: schedule the final rounds for the support lead

Decisions
- The config repository requires one approval for every change from now on.

Action items
- Farhan: add the approval rule to the config repository (due today)
- Neha: write the incident report (due 16 September)

Open questions
- Whether to add an alert on database connection count, and who owns it.

Decisions
- An invoice.paid webhook will be added.

Action items
- Joseph: write the invoice.paid webhook spec (due 30 September)
- Meera: tell both partners the webhook is coming (no date)

Open questions
- Whether webhooks should be versioned.
